column1: All frozen benchmark splits are pooled for this descriptive coverage figure; no model data split is changed.
IL identity is the frozen complete canonical SMILES, not individual cations/anions or measurement rows.
Each IL contributes once per property regardless of temperature, pressure or repeat measurements.
Pairwise counts are inclusive: other measured properties are allowed. Diagonal cells are per-property IL totals.
An IL with k properties contributes to C(k,2) pair cells; pairwise cell counts must not be added to estimate distinct ILs.
Exact-pattern counts are exclusive: filled dots are measured properties; every unfilled dot is unmeasured.
The 228 exact patterns partition all 5,458 ILs. The 218 multi-property patterns partition 2,597 ILs.
Main UpSet plot contains all thirteen multi-property patterns with >=22 ILs, plus the three ILs with all eleven properties.
The remaining 204 multi-property patterns contain 645 ILs; none is merged into a fictitious common membership column.
Full exact-pattern appendix and tables include every nonempty combination, including all single-property patterns.
All_inclusive_subsets enumerates all 2^11-1 = 2047 nonempty subsets, with both inclusive and exact counts.
Histogram: grey = exactly one property; green = exactly two; light purple = three or more.
Exact-pattern bars/dots: green = exactly two measured properties; light purple = three or more; grey singletons appear in the appendix.
Overlap matrix: grey diagonal = per-property totals; green intensity = inclusive pairwise counts on a logarithmic color scale.
Intersection bars and the coverage histogram use logarithmic count axes; printed counts are original integer IL counts.
Overlap indicates availability of shared labels, not value correlation, matched measurement conditions, or demonstrated multitask benefit.
Every pair and all 2047 inclusive subset counts were independently checked using Python sets and exact-pattern sums.
Previously published project overlap, degree histogram and all 228 exact-pattern tables reproduce exactly.
